info.title: FastAPI Mock API Backend
info.description:
A backend-only mock API built with FastAPI.

- `GET /mock` returns a fixed JSON payload for frontend consumption.
- `GET /health` returns service status.

NOTE: `/mock` returns the payload *as-is* (not wrapped) to match frontend expectations.

get.description: Returns the health status of the service.

Returns the mock JSON payload intended for frontend development/testing.

The response body is the payload itself (no extra wrapper fields).

tags.name: Mock
tags.description: Endpoints serving mock payloads for frontend consumption.
